info.title: Dispute Management Endpoints
info.description: The Dispute management API allows you to manage all disputes and chargebacks.

post.description: This endpoint generates a unique URL to embed into your application using an iFrame.

Language.description: The language for the iframe. 'en' for English, 'fr' for French. Defaults to 'en'.

DarkMode.description: Whether to use dark mode for the iframe. Defaults to false.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

Link.description: The URL to embed into your application using an iFrame.

IframeKey.description: A unique key for the iFrame.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of your disputes and chargebacks.

parameters.name: DisputeStatus
parameters.description: Filters results by status: UnderReview, WitMerchant, or Closed. Default is null (i.e., all disputes are returned).

parameters.name: DisputeStage
parameters.description: Filters results by stage. Default is null (i.e., all disputes are returned).

parameters.name: Currency
parameters.description: Filters results by currency. Default is null (i.e., all disputes are returned).

parameters.name: CardBrand
parameters.description: Filters results by card brand: visa, mastercard, amex, discover. Default is null (i.e., all disputes are returned).

parameters.name: FromDate
parameters.description: Filters results that occurred on or after this date/time. Must be specified in YYYY-MM-DD format. Default is 30 days ago.

parameters.name: ToDate
parameters.description: Filters results that occurred on or before this date/time. Must be specified in either YYYY-MM-DD format. Default is the current date/time.

DisputeCardLast4.description: The last 4 digits of the card used for the dispute
